scientific_scope: 同一中性 S 到两个未排序异构体的重排机制及动力学竞争。

required_numerical_evidence.description: S→P2 通道中所研究关键化学事件的实际 Gibbs 活化量及匹配前体/反应态能量、参照；局部 TS 子项不以完整多步路线为前提，竞争项另核查两通道是否足够可比。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed Gibbs activation energy and matched precursor/reactive-state energies for the investigated key event in the S-to-P2 channel. Local transition-state validation does not require a complete multistep route; a channel preference requires sufficient comparable kinetic evidence.

required_numerical_evidence.description: S→P1 通道中所研究关键化学事件的实际 Gibbs 活化量及匹配前体/反应态能量、参照；局部 TS 子项不以完整多步路线为前提，竞争项另核查两通道是否足够可比。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed Gibbs activation energy and matched precursor/reactive-state energies for the investigated key event in the S-to-P1 channel. Local transition-state validation does not require a complete multistep route; a channel preference requires sufficient comparable kinetic evidence.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 共同参照下两通道的 Gibbs 势垒差，说明差值方向；单位 kcal/mol。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: The Gibbs activation-energy difference between the two channels on a common reference, in kcal/mol, with the subtraction order defined.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 指定 S→P2 路线中相连反应剖面的实际能量及相应活化估计，注明原子/构型映射；不以已收敛 TS 作为此项唯一证据。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed connected reaction-profile energies and applicable activation estimates for the proposed S-to-P2 route, with atom and stereochemical mapping; a fully validated saddle is assessed separately.

required_numerical_evidence.description: 指定 S→P1 路线中相连反应剖面的实际能量及相应活化估计，注明原子/构型映射；不以已收敛 TS 作为此项唯一证据。
required_numerical_evidence.public_requirement: Computed connected reaction-profile energies and applicable activation estimates for the proposed S-to-P1 route, with atom and stereochemical mapping; a fully validated saddle is assessed separately.

final_outcomes.description: S→P2 的关键过渡态化学与连接
S→P1 的关键过渡态化学与连接
P2 通道在动力学上更有利

verification_support: 正文 Fig.5、结论及 SI 能量/频率表；历史验证有两条重排通道、相关振动和四方向连接/端点支持。
boundaries: 只覆盖给定 3a/S，不加入论文其他底物的双自由基、负活化能或轨迹结论。
P1/P2 结构已给定，单独重画产物、找到一个 TS 或复述反应名称均不计分。
机制结论与通道排序是不同科学问题；不要求作者的双船构象或固定搜索方法。
路线解释与关键 TS 化学确认分别计分；可靠替代机制可接受，真实分子图/立体映射优先于单独 CIP 标签，算法标签差异不单独导致失分。
source_locator: Main text p4 Fig.5, p14; SI p6
whole_case_success: All required_for_success outcomes must pass for whole-case success; each supported independent outcome retains its weighted points if other outcomes fail.
